notes: Fresh May 20 nightly batch. Selected from search-snippet curation and quick live-access preflight; each selected site must be handled by exactly one isolated GPT-5.5 worker and finalized only after required artifacts pass QA. Quick live preflight inspected 10 selected candidates with Playwright for accessibility before worker handoff.

items.name: Jake's Home Solutions
items.summary: Handyman and home repair Wix site with direct phone/email, service-area list, insured/professional positioning, and multiple service categories that need a clearer quote path.
items.angle: make the county service area, insured experience, and call/email estimate path obvious before the service list

items.name: Ultimate Handyman, LLC
items.summary: Vacaville handyman site with license number, direct contact details, detailed service cards, project photos, and testimonials, but the first screen can sell the trust/estimate path faster.
items.angle: turn the top of the page into a clear licensed local handyman estimate path while preserving the project-photo and testimonial feel

items.name: Handyman Home Services
items.summary: Orlando handyman Wix site with strong owner story, service-area copy, Spanish note, process promise, service list, and reviews, but the hero and contact path are busy.
items.angle: keep the Orlando handyman brand and process promise while clarifying quote CTA, services, trust, and service areas above the fold

items.name: By George! HandyMan
items.summary: Small handyman Wix site with phone, email, Angi/review cue, estimate CTA, and simple service sections, but location/trust/service clarity can be tightened.
items.angle: make the estimate path, service specialties, local trust cues, and phone/email contact more visible in a compact first screen

items.name: Alex Handyman Service
items.summary: Handyman Wix site with direct phone/email, service categories, owner story, and customer quotes, but the call-now banner and service proof need better hierarchy.
items.angle: preserve the current handyman-service structure while making call/quote, service categories, not-a-contractor note, and customer proof easier to scan

items.name: A1 Handyman Service
items.location: Clark County and Nye County, NV
items.summary: Nevada handyman site with phone, email, license number, service list, quote form, and county coverage, but template language and conversion hierarchy can be cleaned up.
items.angle: turn the page into a more credible Clark/Nye County call-and-quote path while separating real service proof from template copy

items.name: JustIn Time Handyman Services
items.summary: Simple Wix handyman site with direct phone/email, insured reliability copy, and core repair/maintenance positioning, but it needs stronger first-screen structure and service proof.
items.angle: keep the straightforward local handyman feel while giving visitors a clearer call/email path and concise service list

items.name: H & T Gutter Services
items.summary: Gutter services Wix site with focused services, free-estimate form, timing expectations, and email contact, but the first screen lacks strong CTA/trust hierarchy.
items.angle: make gutter cleaning, installation, repair, estimate turnaround, and email/contact flow clear before the long form

items.name: DJ Junk Removal Service
items.summary: Sarasota junk-removal Wix site with phone/text numbers, eco-friendly positioning, service list, work gallery, reviews, and local service-area copy, but it needs a more trustworthy quote path.
items.angle: preserve the junk-removal imagery and eco-friendly service list while making call/text/free-estimate actions and service areas obvious immediately

items.name: Ninja Window Washing
items.summary: Family-owned window washing/gutter cleaning Wix site with logo, dual-region phone numbers, service list, and memorable brand line, but the quote CTA and region clarity can be improved.
items.angle: keep the ninja brand/logo and family-owned story while separating Montana/Florida contact paths and making the free-estimate CTA stronger
